name: v1.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* ignore the bot author when renovate looks for edits by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/31
* fold the tracker state and hold it to the h3nc4 gate by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/32
* Update h3nc4/renovate-automerge-action digest to 28ca9fc by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/33
* Update dependency androidx.core:core-ktx to v1.19.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/34
* keep the tracker comments to two lines by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/35
* refresh usage access on resume by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/36
* Update github/codeql-action digest to 2892aa5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/37
* build the dev image on the shared base by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/38
* let ci see the pin commit by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/41
* Update Gradle to v9.8.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/39
* build the throwaway stage on slim by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/42
* take a caching mirror when one is given by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/45
* default to the package mirror when it answers by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/46
* Update h3nc4/dev-base:debian-13 Docker digest to a55541d by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/43
* build through one apt URI, not two by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/47
* use shared action for dev container pin by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/48
* Update h3nc4/dev-base:debian-13 Docker digest to f6afe20 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/49
* Update debian:trixie-slim Docker digest to a29215f by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/50
* Update h3nc4/dev-base:debian-13 Docker digest to eaf04f8 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/51
* Update actions/download-artifact digest to 9000827 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/52
* Update actions/upload-artifact digest to cf430e0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/53
* Update h3nc4/dev-image-pin-action digest to 5285ae6 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/55
* Update dependency org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose to v2.4.21 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/56
* Update github/codeql-action digest to 24c5418 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/57
* Update actions/create-github-app-token action to v3.3.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/58
* draw the HyperOS back belly on side swipes by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/59
* Update github/codeql-action digest to 6f2ac81 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/60
* cancel reverted back swipe by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/61
* refresh readme for current app by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/62
* make release build production ready by @h3nc4 in https://github.com/h3nc4/HyperGesture/pull/63
